integrity: The proof computes the center and every commuting pair directly from the exterior-square bracket. All graph invariants follow from the resulting equal-part complete multipartite decomposition. A standalone checker verifies direct brackets and the predicted decomposition in five finite examples.
scientific_limitations: The exact graph formula is for the free class-two Lie algebra; proper class-two quotients can create additional commuting pairs.
The theorem does not claim graph-theoretic characterization among all finite Lie algebras.
An equivalent projective multipartite observation may exist under different finite-geometry terminology.
title: Free two-step nilpotent Lie noncommuting graphs are projective multipartite graphs
